edges.reason: A binomial success count is defined by repeated independent trials with the same success probability; these Bernoulli-trial assumptions specify the model.
edges.scope: success count in n Bernoulli trials

edges.reason: Interpreting np as the mean requires expectation meaning; no claim is made that the binomial is the only distribution with a mean or variance.
Using np and np(1-p) requires identifying the binomial parameters n and p and the success-count random variable to which the formulas apply.
